items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: She says, “Don’t tell Stanley. That’s my favorite — don’t tell Stanley.”

ctx.x: Thank you. That’s Helen Dance’s favorite song by the way.
Yeah it is. Yeah. She says, “Don’t tell Stanley. That’s my favorite — don’t tell Stanley.”
I may have to say that.
